bio: Dine against the stunning backdrop of the Rotterdam skyline and the Nieuwe Maas River at Restobar Vista. On the ground floor of the De Rotterdam building, the tastefully modern restaurant is done out in muted colours. The team assembled by Henrie van der Heijden, head chef at Vista in Willemstad, creates distinctly French dishes, with the occasional nod to the Mediterranean. Think succulent roasted tournedos on a bed of caramelised onion, accompanied by a rich Madeira sauce and potato rösti. The chefs eschew complexity and delight diners with their unpretentious dishes. The extensive menu and fantastic value for money will bring a smile to your face....
